findings.what: The kit's ShaLink and FileLineLink external GitHub anchors set no rel="noreferrer", and U3 adds more uses of both.
findings.why: W2 says external links carry rel="noreferrer". The kit files are not in this diff and a build node cannot change them. The links open in the same tab, so the only exposure is the Referer header. It is already a U7 acceptance line (ui.dag.yaml:421), as ruled, and is not fixed in this node. Hygiene only, not blocking.
